text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "From 2008 to 2015, Helene Budliger Artieda was head of the Directorate for Resources at the FDFA.", "gist": "Helene Budliger Artieda held the position of head of the Directorate for Resources at FDFA from 2008 to 2015."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "In this capacity, she was advisor to the Head of Department on resource matters and a member of the FDFA Management Board.", "gist": "In her role, she advised the Head of Department on resources and was on the FDFA Management Board."}, {"type": "number", "quote": "2000", "gist": "Year of graduation from Universidad Externado de Colombia"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Universidad Externado de Colombia", "gist": "University in Bogotá, Colombia"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "FDFA", "gist": "Swiss Federal Department of Foreign Affairs"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Federal VET Diploma in Commerce", "gist": "Swiss vocational education and training diploma in commerce"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "After graduating from commercial school in Zurich with a Federal VET Diploma in Commerce, she completed internal training at the FDFA as a consular officer.", "gist": "She graduated from a Zurich commercial school with a Federal VET Diploma in Commerce and then trained as a consular officer at FDFA."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Helene Budliger Artieda is married.", "gist": "Helene Budliger Artieda is married."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Eric Scheidegger", "gist": "Name of a person (likely the author or subject of the text)"}]}
